
  Keyboard shortcuts

  Compose
  !                     Shell Mode
  ctrl+j                New line
  / / @ / $             Pick command / f
  arrows                Move caret / inp
  ctrl+← / ctrl+→       Previous / next 
  alt/option+← / →      Previous / next 
  ctrl+↑ / ctrl+↓       Start / end of l
  alt/option+backspace  Delete previous 
  ctrl+w / alt+del      Delete previous 
  ctrl+k                Delete to end of
  ctrl+z / ctrl+y       Undo / redo
  ctrl+v                Paste image
  ctrl+g                External editor

  Session
  enter                 Send / steer
  tab                   Queue for next t
  alt+↑ / shift+←       Edit last queued
  shift+↑ / shift+↓     Raise / lower re
  /status /session      Settings / launc
  /copy                 Copy response or
  /btw QUESTION         Side question / 
  /model /effort /tier  Open picker or s
  ctrl+c                Clear / interrup
  esc                   Interrupt, keep 
  ctrl+b 1–5            Focus pane
  J (empty draft)       Open journal
  ctrl+b e              Next live item
  ctrl+b q / !          Questions / erro
  ctrl+b ← / →          Resize panes

  Transcript
  ctrl+e       Default / events / all
  pgup / pgdn  Scroll
  esc          Back to bottom
  ? / esc  Close shortcuts
